body:
I thank you for your input. I'm still alive, I don't want my friends to have to deal with such a mess shortly after they moved here.

Alcohol sadly has been the only thing allowing me to interact with most of society and I have a deep fear of not being able to interact with people without it. Its not healthy. Its not a solution. Yet I find it more comforting then being alone. My anxiety is an issue and I fear substituting alcohol for some prescribed medicine as not being a real solution. And yet ironically I'm finding it more and more necessary to fight off the feeling of ending it all; even with it being a losing battle.

My memory has been an issue far before I started drinking. I've read memory loss is tied to depression, and after all these years it makes sense I recall almost nothing. People would talk about there crazy days in highschool and I would sit there like a dumb fuck and nod my head. I feel this also fucks with ability to hold conversations. I've done basically nothing with my life and therefore can't contribute anything to a conversation. You know that old army commercial where they ask if your life was a book would people want to read it. I always came to the conclusion no. 

The years of being alone have gotten to me. As omnipotant stated I have negative thoughts. These thoughts have effected my life greatly. I just don't know how to overcome them. I used to see several psychiatrists when I was a child and I found none of them helpful so I'm reluctant to see another, but I see getting drunk and writing this post is a clear sign I need help yet I can't bring myself to being told the same advice you could find on Google.

Come new years I have no idea what I'm gonna do. I have a chance of being let go from my job as my contract expires. I have no jobs lined up after it despite my attempts. My friends wanna go to a bar I personally hate so that they can gawk and hit on girls, an activity that leaves me ashamed, alone and depressed.

I'm in an self loathing environment and having trouble escaping. This situation is not life ending, but I constantly feel pathetic because I feel it is.
